description.value:
The Ocean War left the seabed full of wrecks, cable and things still armed. Dynalar's replacement for the Aquarius lets salvage crews and rig divers work down there without a suit. The EMP hardening is there because some of those things still go off.

Cost: 15,000eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 47 (14d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: FBC EMP Coating, Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, Radar Detector, Radar/Sonar Implant, Radio Communicator, Self-ICE, Subdermal Armor, Web Foot ×2

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
